about: Gate 211 (TC-R342..TC-R344): on the first training puzzle, Kf1 twice; each wrong-move line shows whole (one painted element, nothing over its box), the second reads 'Kf1 is not a check, and the mate needs one now. Tap 👁 to see the move.' in full, and the board keeps its measured rect (top 173 width 375 at 375x761, top 104 width 320 at 320x568), classic and medieval skins. NOT COVERED: the longest second wrong-move lines over all 876 generated puzzles (only the first puzzle's two lines are driven); the hint and the solved line, which gates 12 and 57 hold; his look.

breaks.name: the-row-cuts-the-line-again
breaks.why: the overflow measurement never marks a line, so at 375x761 the one-line row cuts it with an ellipsis again (the job's defect)

breaks.name: a-two-line-row-moves-the-board
breaks.why: room made the other way: the row is 52px and wraps, so the line shows whole but the board sits 22px lower on every puzzle at 375x761 - it does not move between the readings, so only the measured pin sees it

breaks.name: the-second-line-drops-the-eye
breaks.why: a fix that shortens the second wrong-move line by dropping 'Tap 👁 to see the move.'
